name: Link a Fidget through the LAN test site
reviewer_setup: Precondition: a bench Fidget with saved WiFi settings. The case starts with the test-build verb link forget, which erases the unit's current link, previous-account memory and pending revokes locally (nothing is sent to the site), so every rerun starts from the never-linked state and never stops at a Clear / Keep answer; the following link status step confirms it and fails immediately otherwise. Build and install local_test. In the website worktree, set CF_TEST_DEVICE_DATA_DIR to an empty test directory and run C:/php/php.exe -d auto_prepend_file=tests-node/fixtures/device-pair-prepend.php -S 0.0.0.0:8000 -t . from the site root. Set CF_BENCH_BASE=http://<LAN-IP>:8000. Run python test/bench/cf_replay.py test/bench/cases/device-link.json --port <PORT>. When the six-character code prints, bind it during the 90-second wait with curl --request POST --header 'Authorization: Bearer test-mode-token-1' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"action":"bind","user_code":"<CODE>"}' http://<LAN-IP>:8000/api/device-pair.php . Use a fresh code on every run. Clone check for the reviewer: after a successful link, copy the entire NVS from unit A to a different unit B; B must discard the copied link with the notice and send no credential request, while A remains linked. Do not use a live account for this case.
